title: VisionQuest trailer kicks off Disney's D23 fan event
gist: Disney used day one of D23 in Anaheim to lay out a dated 2026-2028 Marvel and Lucasfilm slate: VisionQuest (Oct 14, 2026, Disney+), Avengers: Doomsday (Dec 18, 2026, theaters), Ahsoka S2 (Jan 20, 2027, Disney+), Star Wars: Starfighter (May 28, 2027) and an X-Men reboot (May 5, 2028), with several reveals gated to attendees only.

insights.claim: Marvel's VisionQuest, completing the WandaVision/Agatha All Along trilogy with Paul Bettany and James Spader, debuts October 14, 2026 on Disney+.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Fixes a Q4 2026 Disney+ tentpole date for anyone modelling streaming subscriber adds and churn around Marvel releases.
insights.quote: VisionQuest debuts on October 14, 2026, on Disney+.

insights.claim: Avengers: Doomsday reaches theaters December 18, 2026, set 14 months after the events of Thunderbolts* and colliding three universes (Earth-616, Earth-828's Fantastic Four, and the 'original' X-Men).
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: A holiday-2026 theatrical tentpole that anchors Disney's box-office comp for the quarter and gates the multiverse arc feeding the 2028 X-Men reboot.

insights.claim: Ahsoka season 2 premieres January 20, 2027 on Disney+, with Rosario Dawson, Natasha Liu Bordizzo and Lars Mikkelsen returning and Rory McCann replacing the late Ray Stevenson as Baylan Skoll.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Places a Star Wars live-action release in the January 2027 window, a period Disney+ has historically used to blunt post-holiday churn.

insights.claim: Star Wars: Starfighter, directed by Shawn Levy and starring Ryan Gosling, opens May 28, 2027 — almost exactly 50 years after the original Star Wars: A New Hope.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: The 50th-anniversary timing signals a maximal marketing push, so expect elevated Lucasfilm P&A spend in FY2027.
insights.locator: Star Wars: Starfighter section, closing line

insights.claim: Marvel's X-Men reboot, directed by Jake Schreier, is dated May 5, 2028, with Christopher Abbott as Professor X, Kit Connor as Cyclops, Samara Weaving as Emma Frost and Adam Driver as Mister Sinister.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Confirms mutants as the multi-year franchise engine Disney is betting on past 2028, a longer-dated IP pipeline than the current Avengers cycle.
insights.locator: The X-Men in the MCU section

insights.claim: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian, a comedic animated retelling of all three seasons of the live-action series, arrives on Disney+ on September 2, 2026.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Low-cost animated derivative content used to extend the life of an existing library title — a margin-friendly streaming tactic worth tracking.
insights.locator: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian section

insights.claim: Disney is stacking three Mandalorian-branded releases on a single day — the LEGO animated special, the streaming debut of the Mandalorian and Grogu film, and the launch of an official Mandalorian and Grogu podcast, all on September 2, 2026.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: A concentrated same-day IP bundle designed to spike sign-ups and engagement in one measurable window rather than spread demand thin.
insights.quote: Disney is also launching an official Mandalorian and Grogu podcast that day, which is also when the film arrives on the streaming platform.
insights.locator: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian section, closing line

insights.claim: Marvel is seeding its 2028 X-Men reboot inside a Sony-distributed Spider-Man film, revealing Sadie Sink's cloaked figure in Spider-Man: Brand New Day as a young Jean Grey.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Shows Marvel using a partner-distributed release as a funnel into its own owned franchise, blurring where the value of a Sony Spider-Man title actually accrues.
insights.quote: Spoiler alert: she plays a young Jean Grey, as much victim as villain.
insights.locator: The X-Men in the MCU section

insights.claim: Disney is running a tiered footage-release funnel in which material shown only to San Diego Comic-Con attendees last month is released publicly at D23, while new Star Wars: Starfighter footage stays attendees-only.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Paid fan events are being used as a staged demand-generation ladder, giving Disney repeated free press cycles per asset — a template other IP holders can copy.
insights.locator: Avengers: Doomsday and Star Wars: Starfighter sections

insights.claim: Marvel's streaming TV output has been inconsistent — a handful of hits, a few misses and a bunch of middling offerings — with WandaVision and Agatha All Along cited as the standouts.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Volume-first streaming strategy has produced weak average quality, so Disney+ retention depends on a few outliers rather than a reliable slate.
insights.quote: Marvel’s streaming TV portfolio has kind of been all over the place: a handful of hits, a few misses, and a bunch of middling offerings.

insights.claim: Star Wars: Starfighter is a deliberate clean break from existing canon — a brand-new story unrelated to the two Skywalker Saga trilogies, set five or six years after The Rise of Skywalker on a previously undepicted watery planet requiring all-new sets and designs.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Lucasfilm is testing whether Star Wars can grow beyond legacy-character dependence — the key question for the franchise's long-run terminal value.
insights.quote: it’s brand new, not related at all to the two trilogies that make up the Skywalker Saga

insights.claim: VisionQuest's premise turns Tony Stark's fictional AI systems into full cast members, with named actors playing F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S. and Ultron as personas embedded in Vision's programming that he consults for meaning.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Mainstream entertainment is normalizing multi-persona AI assistants as characters, a cultural tailwind for consumer AI companion products.
insights.quote: he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron
